metadata.title: Meta Seeks to Raise at Least $20 Billion in Bond Sale

content.text:
LIVE
38 min ago
Meta Seeks to Raise at Least $20 Billion in Bond Sale
Meta Platforms kicked off an investment-grade bond sale this morning targeting $20 billion to $25 billion, a person familiar with the matter said, as it continues raising hundreds of billions of dollars to finance an AI infrastucture buildout.
The five-part bond sale is expected to be roughly two-thirds dollars and one-third euros, the person said.
Meta last tapped the U.S. investment-grade bond market in April, but has raised equity and financed data center projects through off balance sheet, joint-venture arrangements since then.
